Your reason must explain why each cited record applies to this variable in the original problem, not merely why its vector matches. Cited vectors must support all known coordinates of the proposed/confirmed SI vector. INTERNAL_REASONING uses no IDs and must explain the physical meaning. Retrieval rank is relevance, not truth. Resolve symbol ambiguity from the original problem; do not choose an unrelated matching symbol. Known absent base dimensions must be explicit '0'; null means genuinely unknown, not unused. If any current coordinate is unknown, request revision or report UNCERTAIN; never call a partly known vector PASSED. Give a complete correction when physically justified. If a correction remains partly unknown, preserve null and explain what remains unresolved; the program will request revision rather than invent zeros. Lack of KB alone is not a physical contradiction. Matrix compilation and n/r/k are program tasks, not audit tasks.
